company: HSIE Results Daily: ONGC, LG Electronics India, Prestige Estates, Aster DM Quality Care, General Insurance Corporation,
headline: HSIE Results Daily: ONGC, LG Electronics India, Prestige Estates, Aster DM Quality Care, General Insurance Corporation,

highlights: ONGC’s standalone Q2FY27 EBITDA stood at INR 263bn (+48.7% YoY, -10.6% QoQ), broadly in line with estimates.
The QoQ decline was led by softer oil (-6.1%) and gas (-7.8%) realizations, lower oil sales volumes (- 1.0%) and INR 15.6bn provision for terminal excise duty under litigation.

Standalone APAT stood at INR 155bn (+57.3% YoY, -9.1% QoQ). ■ LG Electronics India: Revenue grew by 20% YoY to INR 73.8bn (two-year CAGR 10%), driven by healthy growth across both the segments; home appliances division grew 21% YoY, while home entertainment division grew 17% YoY.
EBITDA margin expanded 60bps YoY to 9.5% (down 300bps QoQ), leading to EBITDA/APAT growth of 28/26% YoY.
valuation: HSIE Research is also available on Bloomberg ERH HDF <GO> & Thomson Reuters 07 November 2026 HSIE Results Daily HSIE Results Daily Contents Results Reviews ■ ONGC: We maintain REDUCE on ONGC, with a revised TP of INR 242/sh, led by limited oil and gas production upside for both FY27/FY28E, due to subsurface issues at KG-98/2 as well as mature fields declining by ~6–8% annually.
It noted that the B2B vertical is emerging as an important growth engine, currently contributing 10-12% of revenue and is targeted to reach at least 15% in the next three years.
On capital allocation and balance sheet trajectory, PEPL is targeting ~INR 45bn of BD spend this year and has asserted that the same is on track for deployment in the coming quarters.
watch: We believe the robust launch pipeline is a key catalyst that will support presale momentum and long-term value creation.

We flag revenue vulnerability if obligatory cessation is abolished, coupled with likely pressure on domestic market share as foreign re-insurer branches, cross‑border re-insurance players, and insurers’ risk‑retention strategies gain traction.
